description_good_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/README.md -- the opening lines say what the software is: the monte3l Claude Code plugin marketplace.
interact_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/README.md and https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md -- how to get it, file issues and contribute.
contribution_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md -- the pull-request process, including how to list a plugin and move a pin, is documented.
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md -- Conventional Commits, DCO sign-off, signed commits, and the field rules a catalog entry must meet, which bin/check-catalog.mjs enforces in CI.
floss_license_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
floss_license_osi_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
documentation_interface_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#listing-a-plugin documents the catalog entry format, field by field, and README.md#working-on-this-repo documents the commands in bin/ (check-catalog.mjs, bump-pins.mjs, smoke-install.sh).
sites_https_justification: GitHub serves everything over HTTPS/TLS, and the docs site https://plugins.monte3l.com is served over HTTPS by Cloudflare.
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues: searchable, addressable by URL, open to anyone, no proprietary client required.
english_justification: All docs are in English; issues and PRs in English are expected and supported.
maintained_justification: Actively maintained: created 2026-10-20 and changed through reviewed pull requests since; see the commit history.
repo_track_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git tracks the changes, who made them, and when.
repo_interim_justification: Commits between changes are visible in git history.
repo_distributed_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git is distributed.
version_unique_justification: This repository publishes no releases of its own. What users get is the catalog at a commit, and every commit has a unique SHA. Each listed plugin is pinned to its own release tag and full commit SHA, and its version is unique in .claude-plugin/plugin.json of its repository.
version_semver_justification: The catalog is not versioned with Semantic Versioning: it is a list, changed by pull request, with no releases. The plugins it lists use SemVer in their own repositories. This criterion is only suggested.
version_tags_justification: This repository creates no tags. Every pin in the catalog is a signed release tag of the listed plugin's own repository. This criterion is only suggested.
release_notes_justification: This repository publishes no releases. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md records every change to the catalog, including each pin bump.
release_notes_vulns_justification: This repository publishes no releases, and no CVE has been assigned against it. SECURITY.md's process commits to a published advisory if one is.
report_process_justification: Bug reports go through GitHub Issues: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/issues (see also https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
report_responses_justification: No bug report has been opened to date, so none is unanswered. SECURITY.md commits to acknowledging a vulnerability report within 7 days.
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests are triaged the same way as bug reports; none has been opened to date.
report_archive_justification: GitHub Issues is a public, searchable archive of every report and response: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/issues
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/SECURITY.md -- GitHub private vulnerability reporting, which is enabled on the repository.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/SECURITY.md commits to acknowledgment within 7 days, under the criterion's 14-day bar.
build_justification: Nothing to build: the catalog is a JSON file and the scripts in bin/ run as committed. The docs site is generated by the vendored m3l-design docs kit and is not the product.
test_justification: The automated checks in https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml test the catalog: bin/check-catalog.mjs asserts every pin against its release tag and the plugin's own manifest, claude plugin validate --strict checks the schema, and bin/smoke-install.sh installs every listed plugin into a throwaway profile. tests/catalog.test.mjs unit-tests the pure parts of bin/.
test_invocation_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/README.md#working-on-this-repo lists the commands, and verify.yml runs the same ones.
test_most_justification: The verify checks lane gates bin/ at 80% statement, branch and function coverage, and measured 91% of lines when added: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml runs the checks on every push and PR.
test_policy_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests -- a change to bin/ adds tests for new behavior and a regression test for a fix.
tests_are_added_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/tests/catalog.test.mjs -- the unit tests for bin/, added with the change that made the catalog checks testable, and run by verify.yml.
tests_documented_added_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests -- says tests are added for new behavior and for a fix.
warnings_justification: ESLint (recommended rules, `lint` lane), CodeQL (javascript-typescript and actions), actionlint, zizmor, shellcheck and reuse lint run on every change.
warnings_fixed_justification: Findings from these tools fail the required verify, CodeQL or workflow-lint checks, so none is merged unfixed.
warnings_strict_justification: Not applicable: no compiler or linter flag to make strict; CodeQL, actionlint and zizmor fail the build on a finding.
know_secure_design_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/SECURITY.md states the scope, secrets handling and accepted risks; the maintainers also keep m3l-groundwork's docs/assurance-case.md (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md), which maps the Saltzer and Schroeder principles.
know_common_errors_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md's CWE Top 25 table, kept by the same maintainers, names the vulnerability types and the mitigation for each.
crypto_published_justification: The project implements and uses no cryptography.
crypto_call_justification: The project implements and uses no cryptography.
crypto_floss_justification: The project implements and uses no cryptography.
crypto_keylength_justification: The project implements and uses no cryptography.
crypto_working_justification: The project implements and uses no cryptography.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: The project implements and uses no cryptography.
crypto_pfs_justification: The project implements and uses no cryptography.
crypto_password_storage_justification: The project stores no passwords for authenticating users.
crypto_random_justification: The project implements and uses no cryptography.
delivery_mitm_justification: Distributed only through GitHub over HTTPS: the repository, and the catalog, whose entries bin/check-catalog.mjs requires to use a full https://github.com/ source URL.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hash is fetched over plain HTTP and used without a signature check.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/SECURITY.md commits to fixing a confirmed medium-or-higher vulnerability within 60 days; none is open, and Dependabot reports no open alert.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: GitHub secret scanning and push protection are enabled, and .github/workflows/gitleaks.yml runs a second scan on every push and PR.
static_analysis_justification: GitHub CodeQL (default setup, javascript-typescript and actions) analyzes every push and PR, more often than each release.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL's default query suite covers common vulnerability classes (CWE-mapped).
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CodeQL is a required check on main, so a confirmed finding is fixed before merge. The one finding it has raised, js/file-access-to-http on bin/lib/catalog.mjs, was dismissed as a false positive with a recorded reason: the URL is built from the repository's own reviewed catalog, after validating each part.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on every push and PR, not just daily.
dynamic_analysis_justification: fast-check property tests (tests/property/, the `property` lane of verify.yml) run the parsers in bin/lib/ against arbitrary generated input on every pull request. This is a dynamic analysis tool, and it found two real defects.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: No memory-unsafe code: JavaScript on a managed runtime, plus shell.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The property tests run with node:assert/strict assertions enabled.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Both defects the property tests found (PR #16) were fixed in the same pull request, with a regression test each.
osps_ac_01_01_justification: The monte3l organization requires two-factor authentication for every member.
osps_ac_02_01_justification: The organization's default repository permission is read; write access is granted by hand.
osps_ac_03_01_justification: The main ruleset requires a pull request with a code-owner approval and the required checks, with an empty bypass list. Direct pushes are rejected.
osps_ac_03_02_justification: The main ruleset blocks deletion of the branch, with an empty bypass list.
osps_br_01_01_justification: No workflow interpolates event metadata into a script: values reach run: steps through env:. zizmor, which flags template injection, runs in CI and reports no findings at its default persona.
osps_br_01_03_justification: No workflow uses pull_request_target or workflow_run. Pull-request workflows hold read-only tokens and no secrets, except the org Gitleaks license, which the Gitleaks job needs. The one write permission, issues: write in pins.yml, is held by a scheduled job that never runs on a pull request.
osps_br_03_01_justification: Every official project URL (the repository, the issue tracker, the security advisory form and the docs site) is served over HTTPS.
osps_br_03_02_justification: The only distribution channels are GitHub and the catalog itself, whose entries must use https:// source URLs.
osps_br_07_01_justification: GitHub secret scanning and push protection are on, and .github/workflows/gitleaks.yml scans every push and PR. Gitleaks is a required check.
osps_do_01_01_justification: The README Quickstart, How it works, Plugins and Working on this repo sections, and CONTRIBUTING.md, are the user and contributor guide.
osps_do_02_01_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md, under Reporting a bug, says what a report must contain. SECURITY.md covers vulnerabilities.
osps_gv_02_01_justification: GitHub Issues is open for discussion of changes and usage problems: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/issues
osps_gv_03_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md explains the contribution process, including that pull requests are limited to collaborators.
osps_le_02_01_justification: MIT, which meets the OSI Open Source Definition.
osps_le_02_02_justification: MIT, which meets the OSI Open Source Definition; the catalog is distributed as this repository.
osps_le_03_02_justification: LICENSE sits at the repository root, so it is inside every checkout and clone the catalog is installed from.
osps_qa_01_02_justification: git history on GitHub records every change, its author and its date.
osps_qa_02_01_justification: The only package-managed dependencies are the CI and deploy tools in .github/ci-tools/ and .github/deploy-tools/, pinned by package-lock.json; every GitHub Action is pinned by commit SHA. The scripts in bin/ use only Node's standard library.
osps_qa_04_01_justification: The catalog lists plugins that live in other repositories, but those are separate products, each documented in README.md#plugins, not codebases of this project.
osps_qa_05_01_justification: The repository holds no generated executable artifacts.
osps_qa_05_02_justification: The only binary files are two vendored .woff2 font files under design/source/fonts/, copied verbatim from a verified m3l-design release and checked against design/SHA256SUMS in CI. They are assets, not executables or libraries. No other binary is tracked.
osps_vm_02_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability gives the private advisory form and the 7-day acknowledgment target.
crypto_used_network_justification: The project implements and uses no cryptography or network protocol of its own.
crypto_tls12_justification: The project implements and uses no cryptography or network protocol of its own.
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: The project implements and uses no cryptography or network protocol of its own.
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: The project implements and uses no cryptography or network protocol of its own.
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: The project implements and uses no cryptography or network protocol of its own.
crypto_credential_agility_justification: No embedded cryptographic credentials are used.
hardened_site_justification: https://plugins.monte3l.com serves Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and a frame-ancestors restriction, from the _headers file the docs kit generates. docs.yml's smoke job fetches the live site after every deploy and requires every one of those headers; docs-live.yml repeats the check daily. GitHub, which hosts the repository, sets its own.
installation_common_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/README.md#quickstart -- `claude plugin marketplace add monte3l/m3l-plugins`, then `claude plugin install <plugin>@monte3l`, the standard way to install a Claude Code plugin.
installation_standard_variables_justific: Installed through Claude Code's plugin manager; there is no DESTDIR-style install-location convention.
installation_development_quick_justifica: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#setup -- clone, then run the checks; the repository's own scripts need no package install.
build_reproducible_justification: Nothing to build: the scripts in bin/ run as committed.
build_repeatable_justification: Nothing to build: the scripts in bin/ run as committed.
build_standard_variables_justification: Nothing to build: the scripts in bin/ run as committed.
build_preserve_debug_justification: Nothing to build: the scripts in bin/ run as committed.
build_non_recursive_justification: Nothing to build: the scripts in bin/ run as committed.
dco_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin -- every commit needs a Signed-off-by trailer, enforced by the `DCO sign-off` job in .github/workflows/verify.yml, a required check.
access_continuity_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#access-continuity -- both owners hold administration independently, and each keeps an emergency access kit.
bus_factor_justification: Honestly 1 today: both owners have full access and one approves every change, but one person has authored all of them. See https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#bus-factor. Growing past 1 is on https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/ROADMAP.md.
documentation_current_justification: Docs are updated in the same pull request as the behavior they describe (CONTRIBUTING.md#scope-of-a-pull-request), and review checks for drift (CONTRIBUTING.md#code-review). No known stale-doc defect is open.
documentation_achievements_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/README.md links the OpenSSF Best Practices badge (project 15760) and the Scorecard badge.
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: The product is a JSON catalog. The docs site is static HTML generated by the vendored m3l-design docs kit, not a web application.
internationalization_justification: The scripts' output is developer-facing status text only; there is no localizable end-user text.
maintenance_or_update_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/SECURITY.md#scope-and-duration-of-support -- only the latest commit on main is supported, and the remedy is to update to it.
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: No vulnerability report has been resolved yet. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/SECURITY.md#credit commits to crediting reporters when one is.
coding_standards_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-standards names ESLint, shellcheck, actionlint, zizmor, REUSE and Conventional Commits.
coding_standards_enforced_justification: The `lint`, `checks` and workflow-lint lanes fail a pull request that breaks them, and all are required through the verify check: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml.
external_dependencies_justification: The only package-managed dependencies are CI tools, listed in machine-readable form in .github/ci-tools/, .github/deploy-tools/, .github/dev-tools/ and tests/property/ package.json and package-lock.json. The scripts in bin/ use only the Node standard library.
dependency_monitoring_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/.github/workflows/dependency-review.yml fails a PR on a high-severity finding or a license outside the allow-list; Dependabot alerts and updates and CodeQL cover the rest.
updateable_reused_components_justificati: Committed lockfiles pin every package by integrity hash, every GitHub Action is pinned by commit SHA, and Dependabot proposes updates for all of them: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml.
interfaces_current_justification: ESLint's recommended rules and the pinned current Node LTS line keep the code off deprecated APIs.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml -- the `catalog` and `plugin` lanes check every pin against the real remote repositories and install every listed plugin into a throwaway profile, on every pull request and push.
regression_tests_added50_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#scope-of-a-pull-request makes it a MUST. The two defects the property tests found (validateDispatch on an object repository, parseLsRemote on a malformed line) each landed with a regression test.
test_statement_coverage80_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml's `checks` lane gates bin/ at 80% statement (line), branch and function coverage with node --test --experimental-test-coverage; it measured 91% lines, 93% branches and 90% functions when added.
test_branch_coverage80_justification: The same gate requires 80% branch coverage of bin/: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml.
input_validation_justification: validateDispatch allow-lists the dispatch payload, parseLsRemote skips anything that is not a 40-hex commit and a ref, entryProblems checks every catalog field, and fetchManifest allow-lists each part of a URL before any request. Property tests feed each arbitrary input.
signed_releases_justification: This repository publishes no releases: the catalog is consumed from main, and every plugin pin is a release tag of the plugin's own repository.
version_tags_signed_justification: This repository publishes no releases: the catalog is consumed from main, and every plugin pin is a release tag of the plugin's own repository.
security_review_justification: No independent security review has been done; the maintainers' own analysis is in https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md.
two_person_review_justification: The main ruleset requires an approval from a code owner who is not the author, with no bypass. Every merged pull request so far carries one from giulmonte.
contributors_unassociated_justification: Both people with access belong to the monte3l organization; see https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#gold-level-criteria-this-project-does-not-meet.
require_2FA_justification: The monte3l organization requires two-factor authentication for every member: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#account-security.
secure_2FA_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#account-security -- an authenticator app or a hardware key; SMS is excluded.
osps_ac_04_01_justification: The default workflow permission is read (repository setting), and every workflow sets `permissions:` at the top: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/.github/workflows/.
osps_ac_04_02_justification: Permissions are set per job and each write scope sits in the job that needs it: issues in pins.yml's check job, pull-requests in labeler.yml, security-events and id-token in scorecard.yml. pins.yml's bump job mints a repository-scoped App token instead of widening GITHUB_TOKEN.
osps_br_01_04_justification: Collaborator-controlled input reaches a shell only through env: variables. pins.yml passes the dispatch repository as PAYLOAD_REPOSITORY, which validateDispatch accepts only as a listed monte3l/<repo> slug. No workflow interpolates a comment, title or branch name into a script, which zizmor checks on every change.

osps_br_05_01_justification: Every dependency is in a package.json and a committed package-lock.json under .github/ci-tools/, .github/deploy-tools/, .github/dev-tools/ and tests/property/. bin/ has none. [external_dependencies]

osps_do_03_02_justification: This repository publishes no releases: the catalog is consumed from main, and every plugin pin is a release tag of the plugin's own repository.
osps_do_04_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/SECURITY.md#scope-and-duration-of-support states what is covered (the latest commit on main) and that there is no fixed duration or long-term-support line.
osps_do_05_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/SECURITY.md#scope-and-duration-of-support states that once a newer commit lands on main the older one receives no fixes, security fixes included, and the remedy is to update.
osps_do_06_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#adding-a-dependency sets the selection criteria; versions are pinned in lockfiles and updated by Dependabot (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml).
osps_gv_01_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles names enri3l and giulmonte, the only people with access.
osps_gv_03_02_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-standards and #scope-of-a-pull-request name the standards and the required gates. [contribution_requirements]
osps_gv_04_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#granting-access is the policy: only an owner grants access, with the other owner's agreement, after a track-record and identity check; access starts at triage; either owner can revoke it; access is reviewed at least once a year.
osps_le_01_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin -- every commit needs a Signed-off-by trailer, enforced by the required `DCO sign-off` job. [dco]

osps_vm_05_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins/blob/main/SECURITY.md#remediation-thresholds: critical or high SCA vulnerabilities block the PR that introduces them and are fixed within 60 days if published against a locked dependency; medium within 60 days; a disallowed license blocks the PR.

osps_vm_06_02_justification: CodeQL default setup analyzes every push and PR, and the CodeQL check is required on main. By GitHub's default it fails on a new alert of error severity or critical or high security severity.
